what: A huge English word spanning the screen width gathers from 50px letter-spacing and transparent to its normal spacing and full clarity in .5s — fires once when the word’s center reaches 75% of the screen height. Letters rush in from both sides and the word settles over the photo (gold DRESS·KIMONO).

options.on: if load, right as it attaches

from.where: index.html .rd-stage__word h3(001 DRESS · 002 KIMONO) — original i("[data-js=dress-section-title]") gsap.from letterSpacing 50px · opacity 0 · .5s · start center 75%
